audit.why: Mounted Kled owning level 1, Akshan taking 2 once Avengerang and the second passive shot exist, and Kled reclaiming the lane past two items is consistent with 55.6% over 9 games. Sides and ratings unchanged.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer named his hook 'Beartrap on a Rope' in eight places and never gave a cooldown for it.
audit.why: Riot's name is Bear Trap on a Rope and it is 11/10/9/8/7s. That number is the whole spike structure of this lane: the hook is his only lock-on, so his all-in windows are literally its cooldown.
audit.corrected: Fixed the name and added the 11s figure in winCon, enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, report[5].t, report[9].t and loading.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions were absent: Jousting is a 13s dash that he can recast to dash back through you, so surviving the first pass is not the end of it; and Violent Tendencies is an auto-attack reset granting four fast attacks, which is the wind-up that actually kills you.
audit.why: Both come from Riot's ability text. The page told you to dodge the hook and said nothing about the two buttons that follow it.
audit.corrected: Added to report[5].t, breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[0].d.

edits.before: Short trades, disciplined swings, and the execute when his kit is down. Nothing here works through Beartrap on a Rope — schedule your pattern around its cooldown.
edits.after: Short trades, disciplined swings, and the execute when his kit is down. Nothing works through Bear Trap on a Rope - it is 11s at rank 1, so schedule your pattern around it.

edits.before: Kled wins by landing Beartrap on a Rope, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Kled wins by landing Bear Trap on a Rope, reeling you in, and dismount-trading before your second passive shot can answer.

edits.before: - Kled Beartrap on a Rope: matchup-defining — The hook starts his all-in — dodge it and disengage his remount. It governs your forward steps. - E swing spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Bear Trap on a Rope: 11s at rank 1, 7s at rank 5 - his only lock-on, so step up the second it misses. - Jousting is 13s and he can recast it to dash back through you, so the first pass is not the end. - Hold R for a dismounted Kled.

edits.before: The hook starts his all-in — dodge it and disengage his remount. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: The hook starts his all-in and it is 11s at rank 1 - until it is spent, every commit is a coin flip.

edits.before: Kled whiffs Beartrap on a Rope and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Kled whiffs Bear Trap on a Rope and 11 seconds of lane belong to you.

edits.before: That is Kled’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: His burst opens with the Violent Tendencies auto reset - four fast attacks land.

edits.before: Track Kled’s Beartrap on a Rope: The hook starts his all-in — dodge it and disengage his remount. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Bear Trap on a Rope is his only lock-on: 11s at rank 1, and if it misses he has only Jousting, which he can recast to dash back through you.

edits.before: Commit on Beartrap on a Rope’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your jungler’s setup. His answer goes first; yours goes last.
edits.after: Commit while Bear Trap on a Rope is on its 11 seconds, on your first item spike, and with your jungler's setup. His hook goes first.

edits.before: If Kled takes first blood, tighten up: Beartrap on a Rope is now always up in your head. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm with Q through the wave and stay an execute threat — R math doesn't care about deficits.
edits.after: If Kled takes first blood, tighten up: assume Bear Trap on a Rope is off its 11 seconds every time. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn't - farm with Q through the wave and stay an execute threat - R math doesn't care about deficits.

edits.before: - Akshan vs Kled - Track: Kled Beartrap on a Rope. - Three hits and out — never flat trades. - No commits into Beartrap on a Rope. - The ultimate closes arguments; it doesn’t open them.
edits.after: - Akshan vs Kled - Track: Bear Trap on a Rope, 11s at rank 1. - Three hits and out, never flat trades. - Hook whiffed means the lane is yours. - Ult a dismounted Kled.

notes: The full layer spelled his Q 'Beartrap on a Rope' throughout; Riot's name is Bear Trap on a Rope. The content layer already had it right, so only the full side needed fixing.
